title: The Wrong Hymn
author: E. M. Okafor
blurb: Rafael Winterbourne, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
